additional_info.subject: ID0473657-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / R8 170002514] EVSE 01 and EVSE 02 Issue CRM:03289000317
additional_info.body:
Dear Nicolas,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided, we can confirm that now the charging station is functioning properly.
Regarding the first charging session you mentioned on DC 1 (2026‑01‑20T07:39:47), was ended by the EV. Please note that issues of this nature are typically related to the vehicles themselves and their onboard safety systems.
Regarding the second session you mentioned (2026-01-21T04:08:00.125), the reboot takes few more minutes before put again online the charger. Now everything is fine.
We will continue to monitor the charger for the next few days. Should the error recur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed to close the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
